description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) enhancement UNSTOPPABLE DESTROYER (Shadowkeepers, WP-C46): the bearer's unit pile-in / consolidation moves are 4" instead of 3", and it can select any consolidation mode regardless of the Before Moving restrictions (ruling: each mode's own condition still applies). Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active (P1 Custodes active; the Blade Champion is engaged with the Deff Dread, on the centre objective); setup privileges: P1 detachment Shadowkeepers, the Blade Champion given Unstoppable Destroyer, CP 0 for both, the owed fights marked resolved (no attacks under test). The Fight phase is ended with the real End Fight Phase button; in the Consolidate step a real click on the Blade Champion opens the ConsolidateDialog with the 'Unstoppable Destroyer — mode:' picker offering Ongoing / Engaging / Objective (12.08 would force Ongoing); picking Objective Consolidation switches the move's mode; the consolidation distance is 4"; Confirm consolidates in Objective mode.

steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["1"]["detachment"] = "Shadowkeepers"
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.units["U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A"].meta["enhancements"] = ["Unstoppable Destroyer"]
var D = load("res://scripts/codex/custodes/CustodesDetachments.gd")
return "%s %.0f" % [str(D.any_consolidation_mode("U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A")), D.fight_move_cap("U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A", 3.0)]

steps.comment: setup privilege: the owed fights are marked resolved (no attacks under test)

steps.script:
var d = tree.current_scene._phase_end_confirm
if d != null and d.visible:
	d.get_ok_button().pressed.emit()
return true

steps.comment: the Orks' half of the Consolidate step first, if it is theirs (not under test)
every mode whose own condition holds is offered (12.08 alone would force Ongoing)
steps.equals: Ongoing Consolidation | Engaging Consolidation | Objective Consolidation

steps.comment: the player picks Objective Consolidation in the picker
